name: Secondary School Program
what_you_do: You take college-credit courses with Harvard faculty. The program runs 4 or 7 weeks in summer 2027. You can take courses on campus, online or as a commuter.
who_can_apply: High school students who will graduate and enter college in 2027, 2028 or 2029. You must be at least 16 by June 13, 2027. You must not turn 19 before July 31, 2027.
pay_detail: 2027 cost $4,180 to $15,980 depending on format and length, plus a $75 application fee. Financial aid is available.
duration: 4 weeks (June 14 to July 8 or July 12 to August 5, 2027) or 7 weeks (June 21 to August 6, 2027)
deadline_text: Application opens December 1, 2026. Early application and priority financial aid deadline January 13, 2027. Regular deadline February 10, 2027. Late deadline March 31, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online at Harvard Summer School when the application opens December 1, 2026. Financial aid is requested during the application.
notes: Expensive and selective. Residential financial aid is limited to U.S. citizens and permanent residents.
